newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS WEEK LARGELY EASIER.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS WEEK LARGELY EASIER.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted weaker against most hard currencies after an otherwise quiet interbank session on Friday, dealers said.
"There was a lot of activity in the morning and then that was it. The rest of the day was very quiet," said one dealer.
He said the local unit ended the day at its morning levels at 10.8950/9100 against the U.S. dollar, which was however a drop from Thursday's 10.8750/8900 close.
On the crosses, it was also quoted weaker against the mark at 6.6900/7025 compared to 6.6300/6500 overnight and shed some points to 2.3580/3640 from 2.3500/3700 against South Africa's rand.
It however finished firmer at 17.7315/7765 against sterling compared to 17.7500/7700.
